testcase.system-out: Scenario: Save and reopen a newly created empty part ✔ Given a new unsaved empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the proposed file name does not already exist in the selected folder ✔ When the user presses Control+S ✔ And the user accepts the proposed file name in the Save As dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the active document tab displays the saved file name ✔ And the model browser root displays the saved file name ✔ When the user closes that document tab ✔ And the user opens the saved file from the same folder ✔ Then the saved part becomes active ✔ And its viewport contains no visible model geometry ✔ And its model browser displays the origin and end-of-part marker
